name: Sa Pa Lake
summary: Town lake under the hill: walk the shore in the evening for the water, the lights, and the grill stalls. Cold nights gather the grills along this water and on the road down to the market. Come for the shore and the food, and stay in town so the walk is short. A clock and the stall prices are for the evening you find.
getThere: Walk from the stone church. The lake is in town.
heroCaption: Sa Pa Lake, the town front, and the ridge
body: Hồ Sa Pa sits in town, with the buildings and the ridge behind the water. Walk the shore in daylight for the reflection, or at dusk when the lights come on along the rail.

On a cold night the grills gather here and on the road that leads down to the market. Plates named for those stalls include grilled salmon, pork skewers, chicken wings, beef with enoki, eggs, and chestnuts. The visit is the water and the food.

figures.caption: The lake shore at dusk, with lights on the hill
figures.alt: Sa Pa Lake at dusk with lights reflecting on the water and the town hill behind

gettingThere: The lake is in town, a walk from the stone church. The national desk places the cold-night grills on this shore and on the road down to the market. A published clock is missing.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk. The lake and the road down to the market are the cold-night grill stops.

admissionNote: Food only. Stall prices are Check on arrival. No lakeside ticket is printed.
